text:
```yaml
name: Check Spy Versions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-spy-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: cargo build --release

    - name: Run version check script
      run: ./ci/check-spy-versions.sh
      env:
        PYSPY_NAME: "pyspy"
        PYSPY_VERSION: "0.3.7"
        RBSPY_NAME: "rb-spy"
        RBSPY_VERSION: "0.6.4"

    - name: Format code
      run: cargo fmt --all --check

    - name: Run tests
      run: cargo test -q
```
